# Reaching-definition scheduling and CFG order

These references were generated by Joern v4.0.555 under JDK 21.0.12. Tests
compare every record of the existing AST/NODES/EDGES/FLOWS projection through
the production C frontend and standard pipeline.

| Input | Complete canonical lines | Baseline differing records | Candidate differing records |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `scheduling.c`: 24 source methods | 3,214 | 21 | 0 |
| `ordering/ordering.c`: 12 source methods | 1,762 | 14 | 0 |
| Existing standalone-block loop-tail diagnostic | 2,042 | 5 | 0 |
| Existing no-block counterexample | 398 | 5 | 0 |
| Broader 32-method macro diagnostic | 3,983 | 63 | 44 |

The [measurement](measurement.json) records the frozen baseline and candidate
binaries, source hash, references, complete differences, and independent
review. The baseline is the third accepted batch, source `b8c2ae132`.
Differing-record counts are multiset differences in both directions; they
are not independent bug counts. Method-block totals include synthetic methods
and therefore exceed source-method counts.

The repair follows the pinned
[ReachingDefFlowGraph](https://github.com/joernio/joern/blob/v4.0.555/dataflowengineoss/src/main/scala/io/joern/dataflowengineoss/passes/reachingdef/ReachingDefProblem.scala),
[DataFlowSolver](https://github.com/joernio/joern/blob/v4.0.555/dataflowengineoss/src/main/scala/io/joern/dataflowengineoss/passes/reachingdef/DataFlowSolver.scala),
and [CfgCreator](https://github.com/joernio/joern/blob/v4.0.555/joern-cli/frontends/x2cpg/src/main/scala/io/joern/x2cpg/passes/controlflow/cfgcreation/CfgCreator.scala):

- GEN and initial OUT include unreachable calls. Those calls have no IN
  solution or call-site DDG processing unless the work list visits them.
- Input and output parameters form explicit chains. Predecessor and
  successor maps differ at method exits, so a later loop update does not
  necessarily reschedule output parameters.
- Each round preserves the work-list order and deduplicates scheduled
  successors by first occurrence. DDG construction reads saved IN states,
  rather than recomputing them from final OUT states.
- CFG edge composition preserves the reference implementation's order.
  Sorting by AST ordinal or selecting the minimum-ordinal exit predecessor
  gives different results for nested loops and disconnected blocks.
- An explicit empty `if` arm contributes the condition's outgoing path.
  It must not disappear merely because an `else` clause exists.

The standalone-block diagnostic's five historical differences are now guarded
as complete exact graphs, both with and without standalone blocks. Its
original files remain under
[`../standalone-blocks/loop-tail-diagnostic/`](../standalone-blocks/loop-tail-diagnostic/).
Existing scanner tests retain all 14 outcomes, including four negatives.
An unreachable call's definition reaching an exit does not establish an
executable source-to-sink path.

`oracle-with-trace.sc` emits the canonical projection plus separate RDTRACE
records with AST ordinals, raw and analysis CFG neighbors, and GEN/KILL/IN/OUT
sets. Independent replay matches GEN/IN/OUT and reverse postorder for 57
methods and 936 nodes across the original scheduling input, broader ordering
probes, and the existing Lua-like string fixture. The latter caught an
intermediate regression: a disconnected block's low AST ordinal incorrectly
selected it as the exit predecessor. That regression is repaired.

The RD-only complete broader probe remains in `macro-diagnostic/`. Its 44 remaining
records (22 missing and 22 extra) describe a preexisting direct-call macro
wrapper type/identity mismatch, including `ANY` versus `void`. They are not
filtered from the reference or presented as exact. The separate ordering
fixture pins control composition without relying on that unsupported macro
form. Internal KILL sets omit IDs that never occur in GEN; the measured
solutions are unchanged. Raw goto predecessor order also differs without a
measured state or output consequence. These bounded results do not establish
complete C or Joern parity.

Run the comparisons with:

```sh
cargo test --locked --manifest-path cpg-rs/Cargo.toml -p joern-parity --test rd_scheduling
cargo test --locked --manifest-path cpg-rs/Cargo.toml -p cpg-analysis --test canonical_c_standalone_blocks
```

The integrated fourth batch fixes the macro wrapper type/identity mismatch. The full 3,983-line broader probe now matches and is enforced by `broader_macro_ordering_diagnostic_is_now_exact`. The table and original measurement above retain the earlier RD-only snapshot; its complete differences have not been rewritten.
